entities.summary: Myron "Mike" Kellin was an American stage and screen actor. He won an Obie Award for his performance in the original Off-Broadway run of American Buffalo, and was nominated for a Tony Award for the Broadway musical Pipe Dream. He was also known for his starring role as Chief petty officer Willie Miller on the 1960s television sitcom The Wackiest Ship in the Army.
